title: Alpine Game Options
doc: Game options for a total conversion mod, read by Alpine Faction only when a mod is loaded.

alpine.notes: Alpine reads this file line by line, not with the game's table parser: lines are trimmed, everything before a line that is exactly #Start is ignored, reading stops at a line that is exactly #End, blank lines and lines starting with // are skipped, and every other line is 'name: value' split at the first colon. Field order does not matter, a later line overrides an earlier one, and unknown names are only logged. Comments after a value become part of the value.

sections.name: #Start
sections.doc: Options between #Start and #End, in any order.

fields.name: $Driller Geomod Smoke Emitter:
fields.doc: Emitter used for driller geomod smoke.

fields.name: $Use Base Game Players Config:
fields.doc: Use the base game's player config file instead of the mod's. 1, true or True mean yes; anything else means no.

fields.name: $Player Undercover Suit Entity Type:
fields.doc: Entity class of the player in the undercover suit.

fields.name: $Player Undercover Scientist Entity Type:
fields.doc: Entity class of the player disguised as a scientist.

fields.name: $Fall Damage Slam Multiplier:
fields.doc: Scales damage from slamming into things.

fields.name: $Walkable Slope Threshold:
fields.doc: Steepest walkable slope as a surface normal threshold (default 0.5).

fields.name: $Player Headlamp Color:
fields.doc: Head lamp colour. Colour as hex RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA, or r, g, b (optionally in { } or < >), quotes optional.

fields.name: $Default Third Person:
fields.doc: Start with the third person camera. 1, true or True mean yes; anything else means no.
